title: Aegis Zenith
body:
This mod is a moderation mod . The mod's goal is to add moderation commands. The mod is still in development.

In summary, this mod is made for people who make modded servers so that they can mod the server.

Aegis Zenith is a high-performance utility and administration framework designed to bridge the gap between player convenience and server management. Built with precision in mind, the mod provides players with advanced data-tracking tools (such as exact playtime and localization) while empowering administrators with a suite of "silent" moderation commands. Whether you are tracking your journey or securing your realm, Aegis Zenith offers the "Zenith" of control and clarity.

Detailed Features
Precision Time Tracking: Uses an internal tick-count algorithm to display total playtime in a human-readable format (Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds).

Geographic Localization: Offers a streamlined alternative to the "F3" menu, providing clean, formatted data about position and environment.

Silent Moderation: Features tools designed for stealth and control, allowing admins to monitor and intervene without disrupting the gameplay flow.

Optimization-Focused: Designed to be lightweight, ensuring that utility commands do not impact server TPS (Ticks Per Second).
 
🛡️ Aegis Zenith: The Ultimate Playtime Engine
Aegis Zenith is a high-precision utility mod designed to track and display your journey's duration with surgical accuracy. No more "about 2 hours" — get the exact count down to the second.

🚀 Why choose Aegis Zenith?
In many modded adventures, time is a resource. Whether you are tracking your survival milestones, timing a speedrun, or monitoring server activity, Aegis Zenith provides a robust, lag-free solution that works seamlessly in the background.

✨ Main Features
⏱️ Frame-Perfect Accuracy: Unlike other mods that use system clocks, Aegis Zenith reads directly from the Minecraft Game Ticks. This means if the server lags or pauses, your timer remains fair and accurate to the actual gameplay.

📅 Intelligent Formatting: The mod automatically converts raw data into a human-readable format: Days, Hours, Minutes, and Seconds.

🍃 Ultra-Lightweight: Coded with optimized procedures to ensure it consumes zero noticeable CPU resources. It’s perfect for massive modpacks (200+ mods).

🛠️ Server & Client Compatible: Works perfectly in Singleplayer worlds and can be used by server admins to track player engagement.

⚙️ How it Works
Aegis Zenith uses a sophisticated logic gate that captures the  value.Entity Ticks Existed

It processes the raw ticks (20 per second).

It runs a real-time mathematical conversion using floor divisions and modulo operations.

It outputs a clean, formatted string whenever triggered.

📖 Planned Updates
[ ] Persistence: Support for saving time across different dimensions.

[ ] GUI Overlay: A toggleable on-screen clock.

📥 Installation
Ensure you have the correct version of Forge or NeoForge installed.

Drop the  into your  folder.Aegis Zenith.jarmods

Launch the game and start your clock!

🤝 Credits & Support
Developed with passion by the Aegis Team. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for the Zenith Engine, feel free to open an issue on our tracker!

The available commands are:

/freeze

/unfreeze

/unban

/gban

/mute

/unmute

/gbanip 

/unbanip

/warn

/unwarn

/aegiszenith

/adminpanel

/noclip

There will be two types of versions: the classic versions, which are updated with new features, and the so-called LTSC versions. These versions will only be updated with bug fixes and optimizations, with no new features, and offer long-term support. They will be marked with LTSC.

This mod is for servers and clients.

Thank you for downloading it.
